title: SpotifySearch
description: supabase/functions/spotify-search/index.ts. Authenticated. Resolves a free-text query (or a split track/artist pair) to a single top-match Spotify track URI via the Spotify Web API Client Credentials flow (catalog/search access only — no user playback scope, so this cannot itself control playback). On macOS, the client then hands the returned URI to the local Spotify app via AppleScript; on Windows this playback step needs its own design (AppleScript has no equivalent — see FEATURE_PARITY_MATRIX.md).

SpotifySearchRequest.title: SpotifySearchRequest
SpotifySearchRequest.description: Provide either `query` (free text) or `track`/`artist` (used together as Spotify field filters `track:X artist:Y` for a more precise match, or individually as plain search terms). At least one of query/track/artist must resolve to a non-empty search string or the function returns 'missing query'.

query.description: Present only alongside error=no_match; echoes the resolved search string.

status.description: Present only alongside spotify_token_failed/spotify_search_failed; echoes the upstream Spotify HTTP status.
